questions.question: Give two reasons why protective clothing is necessary in fermentation units.
questions.solution_html:
• Give two reasons why protective clothing is necessary in fermentation units.
  • a. Prevents contamination of the fermentation process by microorganisms from the worker.
  • b. Protects workers from exposure to harmful chemicals and biohazards.

questions.question: Define primary treatment.
questions.solution_html:
• Primary treatment is a physical process designed to remove large suspended solids and grit from
  • wastewater. It involves screening to catch debris, grit removal for inorganic solids, and sedimentation
  • in primary clarifiers, where organic matter settles as sludge and fats/oils are skimmed off the surface.

questions.question: Mention the role of methanogens in anaerobic treatment.
questions.solution_html:
• Mention the role of methanogens in anaerobic treatment.
  • Methanogens are anaerobic archaea that play the final role in anaerobic digestion. They convert
  • intermediate products such as acetate, hydrogen, and carbon dioxide into methane (CH₄) and carbon
  • dioxide (CO₂). This process stabilises organic matter and helps in biogas production and the reduction
  • of organic pollution in wastewater.
questions.final_answer: of organic pollution in wastewater
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define aeration tanks of water pollution.
questions.solution_html:
• An aeration tank is a unit in the activated sludge process of wastewater treatment where air or oxygen
  • is supplied to sewage to promote the growth of aerobic microorganisms. These microorganisms
  • decompose and oxidise organic pollutants, thereby reducing the biochemical oxygen demand (BOD)
  • of the wastewater.
questions.final_answer: of the wastewater
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Mention the benefits of composting for soil fertility.
questions.solution_html:
• Mention the benefits of composting for soil fertility.
  • Composting improves soil fertility by adding organic matter and essential nutrients to the soil. It also
  • enhances soil structure, water-holding capacity, and microbial activity, which supports better plant
  • growth and soil health. It also reduces the need for chemical fertilisers and improves long-term soil
  • productivity.
questions.final_answer: productivity
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What standard precautions are followed in hospitals and laboratories?
questions.solution_html:
• Washing hands before and after contact with patients or specimens. Wearing gloves, masks, gowns
  • and eye protection when required. Proper disposal of needles and sharp instruments; avoid
  • recapping. Proper cleaning and sterilisation of instruments and surfaces. Segregation and safe
  • disposal of infectious waste. Covering the mouth and nose while coughing or sneezing. Careful
  • collection, transport, and processing of samples. Any 5
questions.final_answer: collection, transport, and processing of samples. Any 5

questions.question: How does proper sanitation help in preventing food contamination?
questions.solution_html:
• Cleaning utensils, surfaces, and hands reduces bacteria, viruses, and parasites that can spoil food or
  • cause disease. Keeping raw and cooked foods separate and using clean equipment stops germs from
  • spreading. Proper washing of fruits, vegetables, and food-contact surfaces removes pesticides and
  • harmful chemicals.
questions.final_answer: harmful chemicals
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the applications and importance of air sanitation techniques in public places, hospitals and industries?
questions.solution_html:
• and industries?
  • Air sanitation- reduction or elimination of microorganisms present in the air to maintain hygienic and
  • safe environmental conditions. . Importance of Air Sanitation - Maintains a hygienic indoor
  • environment and protects public health. a.Hospitals: Air sanitation prevents hospital-acquired
  • infections in operating theatres and ICUs. b. Microbiology Laboratories: Maintains sterile conditions
  • for microbial culture and research. c. Food Processing Industries: Prevents contamination of food
  • products. d. Pharmaceutical Industries: Ensures a sterile environment for drug production. e. Public
  • Buildings: Used in airports, schools, and offices to improve air quality.
questions.final_answer: Option Hospitals: Air sanitation prevents hospital-acquired
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the causes, symptoms, transmission, and preventive measures of any two parasitic waterborne diseases.
questions.solution_html:
• waterborne diseases.
  • a.Cryptosporidiosis, Causative agent: Cryptosporidium parvum (a protozoan parasite). Symptoms
  • Watery diarrhoea, Abdominal cramps, Nausea and vomiting, Fever and dehydration. Transmission
  • Infection occurs by ingestion of oocysts through contaminated water or food. It can also spread
  • through the fecal–oral route and contact with infected persons or animals. Preventive measures
  • Drink safe, properly treated water, maintain good personal hygiene and hand washing, avoid
  • consumption of contaminated food and water, and practice proper sanitation and waste disposal.
  • b.Giardiasis-Causative agent: Giardia lamblia.Symptoms: Diarrhoea (often greasy or foul-smelling)
  • Abdominal cramps and bloating, nausea, fatigue, and weight loss.Transmission: Spread through the
  • fecal–oral route by ingestion of cysts in contaminated water or food. It can also occur through
  • person-to-person contact or poor hygiene. Preventive measures: Drink safe and properly treated or
  • boiled water, maintain good personal hygiene and regular hand washing, ensure proper sanitation
  • and disposal of human waste, and wash fruits and vegetables properly before consumption.
questions.final_answer: Option Cryptosporidiosis, Causative agent: Cryptosporidium parvum (a protozoan parasite). Symptoms
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
